tagline: ASCII tic-tac-toe over HTTP, played with curl to teach client/server
short_description: A text-based tic-tac-toe game served by FastAPI that responds in pure plain text, playable by two players using curl or a browser.
long_description: fast-ttt is a minimal teaching tool that demonstrates client/server principles using a game of tic-tac-toe. Two players interact over plain HTTP with curl or a web browser, and the FastAPI server replies with ASCII boards and text only — no HTML, JavaScript, CSS, or JSON (the sole exception being FastAPI's auto-generated Swagger UI at /docs). It supports creating games, viewing boards, playing numbered moves, random auto-moves, per-game move history, and home-page statistics, with winning lines highlighted. Game state is persisted in SQLite via SQLAlchemy, and moves commit atomically across board, turn, status, and history. Docs (OVERVIEW.md and FAST-API.md) are served by the app itself to explain how clients and servers communicate.
notes: No GitHub Pages and no CNAME, so live_url is null. Positioned by the README as a teaching tool for client/server concepts rather than a standalone game, hence Education & Teaching. Local-only server at 0.0.0.0:8000.
